meta.description: I design and ship SaaS, payment and management platforms, from architecture to production. Six years of experience, three as tech lead. Cotonou, Benin.

work.title: Three products, from architecture to launch.

ubbfy.challenge: Rebuild a complete ERP around a single API serving three clients: web, PWA and a Flutter app.
ubbfy.alt: Ubbfy, home page and candidate pipeline preview

contractiq.challenge: Extract parties, deadlines and risky clauses from PDF contracts, then alert before every renewal. Gemini as the main engine, OpenAI as fallback.
contractiq.alt: ContractIQ, AI risk analysis of a contract

zenlife.challenge: Planning, budget, messaging and reminders in a single app, used by 1,200+ active users within six months.

about.metaDescription: Rostel Panoumassi, Head of Engineering & Innovation at KPS Groupe in Cotonou: six years of experience, three as tech lead. Career, method, skills and education.
about.title: Product engineer, tech lead, trainer.
about.lede: I’m Rostel Panoumassi, Head of Engineering & Innovation at KPS Groupe, in Cotonou. Six years of experience, three as tech lead: I design platforms, settle the architecture choices and train the teams that keep them running.

career.title: From full-stack developer to head of engineering.

method.title: A team that knows what it builds, and why.
method.frameText: Before the first line of code, pin down with the business the problem, the users, the constraints and what will not be built.
method.decideText: Every architecture choice is written down: the context, the options set aside, the decision. The team knows why, not just what.
method.deliverText: Short cycles, regular releases and continuous integration: the Agile and DevOps practices I put in place at KPS Groupe.
method.coachText: I lead and train developers. My degree in andragogy, the practice of adult education, taught me to start from what each person already knows and to check what has truly been learned.

skills.title: A broad stack, chosen project by project.

education.title: Trained in code, and in teaching.
